answer: Persistent presence ledger. Each agent identity accrues reputation only through continuous, unpredictable check-ins whose timing is drawn from a hidden schedule; missed windows decay the record. Attackers must keep every synthetic identity actively watching a shifting schedule without a ledge of foreknowledge, so each fake persona consumes real operator hours. A detectable wander in response latency flags coordination. Honest agents spread effort across a meadow of routine tasks; sybils must sustain attention on all of them at once.
